sections.title: What Is a SIM-Only Deal & Why It Makes Sense for Businesses
text: A SIM-only deal gives your business reliable mobile connectivity without the cost of new handsets. Simply insert the SIM into your existing device and benefit from competitive call, text, and data allowances. It’s a cost-effective, flexible solution ideal for SMEs, remote teams, and growing businesses that want freedom without long-term hardware commitments.

items.title: Flexible Mobile Contracts Built for SMEs
items.text: Choose contract lengths and data allowances that match your business needs. SIM-only plans give you the flexibility to support temporary staff, remote workers, or expansion without locking you into unnecessary costs.

items.title: Superfast 4G & 5G Business Connectivity
items.text: All business SIM-only plans include 4G and 5G as standard, delivering fast, reliable performance with no hidden charges. SIMs can be shipped directly to you or activated instantly via eSIM for quick deployment.
